newsitem.title: USA: Casino Resource says Q3 revs were $4.6 mln. [CORRECTED 09:15 GMT 12/7]
newsitem.headline: Casino Resource says Q3 revs were $4.6 mln. [CORRECTED 09:15 GMT 12/7]

text.p: Casino Resource Corp said Friday its third quarter revenues were $4.6 million compared to $3.7 million for the same period a year ago, and it also expects to report a profit for the quarter.
(Corrects third quarter revenues from $4.0 million to $4.6 million, headline and text.)
The company said the quarter ended June 30.
The company also said it "should now accelerate" its growth with the opening of its casino and 500-seat theatre in Tunisia, North Africa scheduled for September 12.
